access.title: Manage access
access.subtitle: Share this vault without exposing your user directory.
access.add_member_help: Type at least two characters of an active username. Suggestions appear as you type, without listing the full user directory. Confirm the exact person before sharing this vault.
access.owner_locked: The primary owner cannot be assigned another role.
access.remove_member_confirm: Remove this user from the vault?
access.quotas_help: Quotas cap how much this vault can store, how many jobs can run at once, and how much restore traffic it may use in 30 days. Leave a limit blank for unlimited.
access.quotas_soft_help: The warning limit can be exceeded. FrostVault still allows work, but shows a warning so you can act before a stop.
access.quotas_hard_help: The stop limit cannot be exceeded. New matching work is blocked until usage is back under this value.
access.quotas_storage_help: Cloud Archive Version data counted toward this vault.
access.quotas_concurrency_help: How many vault jobs may run at the same time.
access.quotas_restore_help: Cloud restore traffic used in the last 30 days.
access.quotas_form_help: Edit warning and stop limits on each card. Storage and restore use bytes; concurrency uses job counts. Blank means unlimited.
access.quotas_ok: No active warnings or blocks reported.
access.quotas_soft_exceeds_hard_storage: Soft storage limit cannot exceed the hard limit.
access.quotas_soft_exceeds_hard_concurre: Soft concurrency limit cannot exceed the hard limit.
access.quotas_soft_exceeds_hard_restore: Soft restore 30-day limit cannot exceed the hard limit.
access.quotas_reason_required: Enter a reason for this quota change.
access.quotas_wait_loading: Wait for the selected vault quotas to finish loading.
access.retention_help: This only removes Local Copies from the vault folder. Cloud Archive Versions stay recoverable. Automatic cleanup is off until you enable it.
access.retention_example: Example: with 45 days, a Local Copy may be removed 45 days after its matching Archive Version is verified. The file’s local modification time is never used.
access.retention_never: Cleanup is queued, then rechecks the exact fingerprint before deleting. If the local file changed, it is left alone. Manual Free local space remains available.
access.retention_days_help: Changing this value recalculates eligibility during the next vault scan. Manual cleanup remains available.
access.retention_days_required: Enter at least one retention day before enabling automatic cleanup.
access.policy_help: These patterns decide which Local Copies may be uploaded automatically. They do not delete files and do not change files already in the cloud.
access.policy_include_help: Include patterns. Empty means every Local Copy is eligible. Example: reports/** or *.pdf
access.policy_exclude_help: Exclude patterns always win. A file matching both include and exclude is not auto-uploaded. Example: tmp/** or **/*.tmp
access.policy_preview_help: Paste a few vault-relative paths to see which current patterns would include or skip. This does not save the policy.
access.policy_preview_skipped_exclude: Would be skipped by an exclude rule.
access.policy_preview_skipped_include: Would be skipped: it does not match the include rules.
access.lifecycle_help: Guided storage-class profiles apply through object tags, so crypt vaults do not need readable key prefixes. Changing a profile retags over time and updates application-owned S3 lifecycle rules.
access.lifecycle_choose_profile_error: Choose a lifecycle profile before saving.
access.lifecycle_override_incomplete: Enter a folder path and choose a lifecycle profile.
access.lifecycle_class_onezone_ia_help: Less frequent access · single Availability Zone
access.lifecycle_absolute_help: Build the storage journey from top to bottom. Each day is counted from the Archive Version’s creation, not from the previous transition.
access.lifecycle_enable_noncurrent: Use a separate journey for previous versions
access.lifecycle_noncurrent_help: Applies after an Archive Version is replaced by a newer one.
access.lifecycle_transition_summary: On day {days}, move this Archive Version to {storageClass}.
access.lifecycle_error_days_absolute: Use an absolute day strictly greater than the previous rule.
access.lifecycle_error_depth: {storageClass} must be deeper than the previous class; same-band classes are not allowed.
access.lifecycle_error_minimum: {storageClass} requires at least {days} days from creation.
access.lifecycle_cold_warning: Cold storage can add retrieval charges and minimum storage-duration billing, even when data is deleted early.
access.cloud_deletion_help: Cloud deletion is off by default. Reversible archival creates a Delete Marker that hides the current key without deleting Archive Version data. Permanent purge is a separate action with confirmation and a cancellable delay.
access.cloud_deletion_enabled_state: Cloud deletion is enabled for this vault.
access.cloud_deletion_toggle: Enable cloud deletion workflows for this vault
access.transfer_message: Transfer primary ownership to {name} (@{username})? This changes the vault authority and does not move stored files.
access.transfer_mismatch: Type the exact username to confirm the transfer.

ui.cloud_purge_confirm_label: Type the vault name ({vault}) or this phrase to confirm

job.storage_class_restoring: Waiting for {storage_class} restore before changing storage class; RestoreObject cannot be cancelled after AWS accepts it
ui.row_action_storage_class_hint: Move cloud Archive Versions to a chosen S3 storage class now (one-shot Job).
ui.row_action_lifecycle_pin_hint: Stop automatic storage-class transitions for this path until you unpin it.
ui.row_action_lifecycle_unpin_hint: Allow automatic lifecycle policy to apply again (deepening only; no warm-up).
ui.storage_class_confirm_body: Change {count} cloud object(s) ({bytes}) from their current class to {target}. This does not edit the vault lifecycle profile.
ui.storage_class_confirm_warning: Cold classes (GLACIER_IR / GLACIER / DEEP_ARCHIVE) add retrieval latency and may incur early-delete or minimum-duration charges.
ui.storage_class_restore_warning: The current Archive Version needs an S3 restore first (~{hours}h, ~€{cost}). This Job will restore then change class; RestoreObject cannot be cancelled after AWS accepts it.
ui.storage_class_pin_after: Pin this path from automatic lifecycle after the change
ui.storage_class_policy_note: Without a lifecycle pin, deeper policy steps may still apply later. Automatic policy never warms an object.
ui.lifecycle_pin_confirm_body: Automatic storage-class transitions will stop for this path until you unpin it.
ui.lifecycle_unpin_confirm_body: Lifecycle policy may deepen this object again. It will not warm it back to a shallower class.
ui.vault_storage_class_hint: One-shot Job for every eligible cloud Archive Version in this Vault. Does not edit the lifecycle profile.

decommission.title: Decommission Vault
decommission.description: Review and explicitly choose what happens to {vault} before its local root is released.
decommission.owner_panel_help: This is separate from disabling the Vault. The root remains reserved until every selected disposition is verified.
decommission.local_retain_help: Leave every local file untouched when the root is released.
decommission.local_remove_help: Use verified free-space protections to remove only Local Copies that exactly match available Archive Versions.
decommission.cloud_retain_help: Keep Archive Versions, Delete Markers, cloud namespace, and encrypted recovery material.
decommission.cloud_purge_help: Use the permanent-purge delay and exact provider-version deletion protections. This cannot be undone after deletion begins.
decommission.tombstone_help: The Vault tombstone, memberships, Jobs, Vault File identity, Path History, audit history, and encrypted recovery material remain recorded.
decommission.confirmation_mismatch: The confirmation must match the exact Vault name, including case.
decommission.root_released: The local root has been atomically released. The Vault remains as a tombstone.
decommission.root_reserved: The local root remains reserved until both dispositions are terminal and verified.
decommission.blocker.active_jobs: Active or pending Jobs must finish first ({count}).
decommission.blocker.pending_destructive: A pending destructive action must reach a terminal state ({count}).
decommission.blocker.scan_active: Wait for the running Vault scan to finish.
decommission.blocker.relocation_in_progr: Complete the mandatory relocation scan first.
decommission.blocker.decommission_in_pro: This Vault is already being decommissioned.
decommission.blocker.already_decommissio: This Vault root has already been released.
decommission.blocker.source_unavailable: Restore the expected healthy read-write Source Volume before decommissioning.
decommission.blocker.root_identity_ambig: The Vault root has no enrolled identity and cannot be released safely.
decommission.blocker.root_identity_misma: The Vault root does not match its enrolled identity.
decommission.blocker.filesystem_unreadab: The Vault root could not be inventoried safely.
decommission.blocker.local_catalog_stale: Run a full local scan: the filesystem and Local Copy catalog differ.
decommission.blocker.local_unsupported_e: Local removal cannot delete symlinks, special files, or nested mounts ({count}).
decommission.blocker.local_delete_disabl: Local Copy deletion is disabled by system policy.
decommission.blocker.local_copy_unprotec: Every removed Local Copy must exactly match a verified available Archive Version ({count} blocked).
decommission.blocker.cloud_deletion_disa: Enable permanent cloud deletion for this Vault before choosing purge.
decommission.blocker.cloud_identity_inco: Cloud history lacks an exact provider version identity ({count}).
decommission.blocker.recovery_custody_un: Confirm crypt recovery custody before retaining cloud history.
decommission.blocker.owner_missing: Assign one primary owner before decommissioning.
